tess: Drafting the internal RN for rwd-infer@v2.5.0. Proposed microrollout window: 2026-04-02 01:00-02:00 UTC. Need ops pin + deploybot schedule.

tess: RN (short):
```
v2.5.0 - runtime/migrations
- Faster KV-cache resume for returning sessions
- p99 tail latency reduced for long-context paths (~12%)
- opt-in: `max_tokens_per_request` to cap memory usage
- DB: staged online index build on requests.created_at (per-shard, throttled)
```

tess: Rollback thresholds proposed: sustained 1%+ 5xx OR p99 >1.7x baseline for 10m OR QA eval regressions >3%. Owners: @omar oncall, @rukmini infra, @ben comms.

omar: I'll take the oncall window. Suggest canary 3% for 15m then 15% for 10m before full. If p99 crosses 1.7x I'll flip traffic to the pinned fallback and abort.

rukmini: Infra checklist: confirm per-shard throttling, verify index nodes have >30% headroom, pause low-priority batch jobs during migration. I'll run smoke at 00:30 UTC and post results.

ben: Comms: internal announce should explicitly say "no expected customer-visible downtime; dedicated customers pinned to older minors unaffected" and include quick rollback steps + dashboard link. I'll prep the blast.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-04-02 01:05 UTC (3% traffic, 15m) -> ramp 15% at 01:25 UTC -> full rollout 01:40 UTC if metrics OK. CLI: `deploybot release --env prod --version rwd-infer@v2.5.0 --canary 3% --watch`.

tess: Updated RN snippet for internal blast: 
```
Internal: Rolling microrollout of rwd-infer@v2.5.0 on 2026-04-02 01:00-02:00 UTC. No expected customer downtime. DB migration: staged online index build on requests.created_at (per-shard, throttled). Rollback triggers: sustained 1%+ 5xx, p99 latency >1.7x baseline for 10m, QA drift >3%. Owners: @omar oncall, @rukmini infra, @ben comms. Deploybot: `deploybot release --env prod --version rwd-infer@v2.5.0 --canary 3%`. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/v2-5-microrollout
```

pager-bot: pager-bot: Reminder created for @omar at 00:50 UTC and 01:05 UTC.

omar: Please add the short runbook steps in the blast: 1) abort canary via deploybot 2) flip fallback route 3) roll back DB index change plan. Ben can you add that?

ben: Yup will include a 3-step rollback in the blast and send at 00:45 UTC.

tess: If no objections I'll mark RN ops-ready in 10m and lock the pin. Thanks all :thumbsup:
